t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To pick on each colour gnome to see what value it gives. If low then more onto another colour. Should be able to see a pattern emerge. But this may be changed during the game.

vb_textbox.text: Start by selecting all the different colour, where it gives a low colour then choose the different one next. You might be able to spot a pattern emerging of which ones give more points. This however may be swapped up so be aware. If there is a low giving colour before then select the other colour on your next go.
